summary: Mingteng International Corp Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement closed June 18, 2026. The company issued 457,355 Class A ordinary shares at $2.00/share and pre-funded warrants for 1,022,645 shares at $1.99995 each, plus private warrants for 1,480,000 shares exercisable at $2.00. Gross proceeds were approximately $2.96 million for working capital. Lock-up agreements apply to directors and officers for 60 days. This is an ordinary capital raise under an effective shelf registration, not a special situation.
